lines.differs: Worse for AtliQ than Rohan Iyer: 90-day payment terms instead of 30 days, plus a 90-day invoice waiver deadline.
Worse for AtliQ than Trustline NBFC: payment terms are 90 days instead of 45 days, and unbilled invoices are waived after 90 days.
Worse for AtliQ than PayTrack Technologies: payment terms are 90 days instead of 30 days, and unsubmitted invoices are deemed waived after 90 days.
Worse for AtliQ than Al Noor Hospitality Group: requires holding confidential information in strict confidence rather than using reasonable care.
Worse for AtliQ than Crestline Retail Inc: confidentiality obligations do not expire after three years post-termination.
Better for AtliQ than Rohan Iyer: standard mutual confidentiality terms without specific prohibitions on downloading data to personal devices.
Worse for AtliQ than Rohan Iyer: AtliQ assigns all IP in deliverables and pre-existing materials instead of retaining IP ownership and granting a license.
Worse for AtliQ than Al Noor Hospitality Group: IP transfers upon creation without requiring full payment, and AtliQ assigns pre-existing materials.
Worse for AtliQ than Orbit Travels Pvt Ltd: IP is assigned from creation without requiring full payment, and AtliQ loses ownership of pre-existing materials.
Worse for AtliQ than PayTrack Technologies: one-sided indemnity covering all losses from any contract violation or service, regardless of fault.
Worse for AtliQ than Orbit Travels Pvt Ltd: indemnifies for all losses and services regardless of fault, rather than only third-party IP infringement claims.
Worse for AtliQ than Acme Retail Group: indemnity is one-sided and covers all losses from any contract violation, rather than mutual third-party claims.
Worse for AtliQ than Sunrise Foods: liability cap and indirect damages exclusion apply only to Client, leaving AtliQ's liability completely uncapped.
Worse for AtliQ than Rohan Iyer: AtliQ's liability is completely uncapped and unexcluded, whereas liability was previously mutually capped.
Worse for AtliQ than PayTrack Technologies: liability cap and consequential damage exclusions protect only Client, leaving AtliQ with uncapped liability.
Worse for AtliQ than Acme Retail Group: 2% of total contract value per day uncapped, versus 0.5% of milestone fee per week capped at 5%.
Worse for AtliQ than Brightwater Insurance Inc: liquidated damages rate is 2% of total contract value per day rather than 1%.
Worse for AtliQ than Al Noor Hospitality Group: 2% of total contract value per day instead of 1% of affected milestone fees, without delay relief.
Worse for AtliQ than CareBridge Clinics Inc: mandates compliance with NIST SP 800-53 moderate baseline security standard in addition to HIPAA controls.
Worse for AtliQ than Brightwater Insurance Inc: requires meeting NIST SP 800-53 moderate baseline standards, though it lacks Brightwater's prohibition on foreign data processing.
Worse for AtliQ than AtliQ Technologies Pvt Ltd (intercompany): requires maintaining a formal NIST SP 800-53 moderate baseline security program.
Worse for AtliQ than Al Noor Hospitality Group: governed by Texas law and Harris County courts instead of DIFC law and courts.
Worse for AtliQ than CloudSpan Technologies: disputes are subject to Texas litigation in Harris County courts rather than SIAC arbitration in Singapore.
Better for AtliQ than Brightwater Insurance Inc: includes a mandatory 30-day executive escalation process to resolve disputes before court action.
